note.text: Split the six objects into two groups of three. If only one group lights, both nexioms are in it: a dark group cannot contain a nexiom under “needs one,” and cannot contain both under “needs two.” Test singles, then pairs, inside the lit group. A single light means needs one; a pair that lights only together means needs two. If both groups light, the machine needs one and each group holds one nexiom. Test singles in each group. If neither group lights, the machine needs two and the nexioms are split one per group. Find the cross-pair that lights. Objects outside a confirmed pair never matter. You only need the complementary tests, not all six.
